connector.name: Snug Planner
connector.registryDescription: The first official family-planner MCP: tasks, calendar, meals, shopping and reminders.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.snugplanner.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.snugplanner, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Your Snug Planner API key as a Bearer token. Generate one in Snug under Settings. Format: 'Bearer snug_sk_...'
